Cosmic Funk 3 9-8 G Lyons Nicola Burns (5) 10-1 - - - Price rose from 34,000euros to 38,000euros from foal to yearling; first foal; dam unraced half-sister to winners Majestic Myles (7f Listed), Parbold (Group-placed 6f 2yo) and Majestic Moon (useful 6f/7f); top yard; market can guide but tricky draw to overcome. Keogie 3 9-8 N Meade Colin Keane 6-1 - 47 78 21,000euros yearling; half-brother to Czech 7f 2yo/1m3f winner Riwetta; promising debut when 2.5l second at the Curragh 38 days ago on heavy, staying on well to come clear of remainder; step up in trip should suit; chance with more to come. Lord Aus 3 9-8 J Murtagh Jamie Powell 14-1 - 66 68 Looked badly in need of the experience when beaten 12.5l into eighth on debut at Navan over 1m2f 23 days ago; should progress but plenty of stamina in pedigree and drop in trip not sure to suit. Ocean Echo 3 9-8 M Fahey Gavin Ryan 14-1 - - - Awtaad gelding; fourth foal; half-brother to winners Arabian Story (1m inc AW; RPR 105) and Olympic Candle (6f-1m inc 2yo/AW; 93); dam French 6f-8.5f maiden (73), half-sister to 1m Group 1 winner Territories, out of useful 1m/1m1f 2yo winner; well-bred type been gelded before debut; market can guide. Perisher 3 9-8p J P O'Brien Declan McDonogh 11-2 80 84 89 Promise in three maidens last year on varying ground, including when third at Listowel on heavy (beaten 8l into third by Straight Up); ran well on handicap debut 18 days ago when 2.25l third to Empty Wallet, first run since being gelded and in first-time cheekpieces; should be thereabouts for in-form stable. Priorstown 3 9-8 J Murtagh N G McCullagh 14-1 - 55 66 Showed ability when beaten 11l into sixth on debut at Navan (1m, heavy) 23 days ago; should come on for that but may need further to show best. Rapide Vega 3 9-8 Mrs J Harrington Shane Foley 12-1 - 49 75 Improved plenty for first run and a break last year when stepped up to 7f in Galway maiden in October, beaten 5.5l into fourth; third has won since; off 177 days and type to progress as 3yo; up in trip. Borora Aura 3 9-3h M Mulvany Wesley Joyce (3) 25-1 - - 32 Well beaten seventh at Bellewstown 11 days ago on debut; wears hood; needs significant improvement to figure. Casla's Eagle 3 9-3 P Fahey Gary Carroll 20-1 - - - Gleneagles filly; dam 1m winner (RPR 77), half-sister to winners Square Dance (7f 2yo/1m), Concessions (7f 2yo) and Balcony (1m), out of smart 1m-1m4f winner; makes debut for good yard that doesn't have many 3yo runners on the Flat; market can guide. Jojo's Legacy 3 9-3 A Slattery Seamie Heffernan 7-1 77 85 89 Three promising runs last year on yielding to good, beaten 3.5l into fourth behind dual Group 1 winner Precise at Cork in September over 1m; below that when beaten 7.5l into eighth on AW 47 days ago; chance if coming on for that; stable in form. Meriden 3 9-3 D Hogan Robbie Colgan 33-1 - 55 65 Not shown enough in two starts this year over 6f on soft ground at the Curragh and on the AW to suggest she's ready to win a contest of this nature; more of a long-term project; up in trip. Sanctijude 3 9-3 W McCreery W J Lee 7-2 83 75 90 Seven-race maiden but some good efforts and placed four times, including over course and distance in October when beaten a nose by Marjorie Dew; good return to action when beaten 2.5l into fourth by Drop Dead Gorgeous at Naas on soft 31 days ago, awkward away; consistent, has experience edge and obvious player. Sands Castle 3 9-3 A Sexton Killian Leonard 66-1 - - 17 Didn't beat many rivals in two starts last year; up against it. Page 1 spotlightgowran park 22.04.26 Tavarua 3 9-3 K Condon Ronan Whelan 22-1 - 48 62 Showed something to work on but well-held when sixth on debut at this track 14 days ago; needs plenty more.

1m For 3yo whose sire established one or more yearling sales in the relevant year with a median price of not more than 50,000 euros Weights 9st 8lbs Penalty value 1st £€10,013 2nd £€3,213 3rd £€1,513 4th £€663 5th £€323 6th £€153 SFT-HVY Trainer Jockey SP OR TS RPR Alphonsus Liguori 3 9-8 J P O'Brien J M Sheridan 13-2 - - - Cost 210,000gns as a yearling; Study Of Man colt; half-brother to winners Galmarley (1m5f;

tricky maiden but plenty of form to go by and JOJO'S LEGACY is worth siding with for the in-form Andy Slattery stable. She showed plenty of promise in three maidens last year but didn't run to that level at Dundalk when last seen. Back on turf, she could provide some value. Sanctijude is winless in seven starts but is consistent and has course and distance form to her name having gone close here in October, while trainer Joseph O'Brien is in sparkling form and saddles Perisher who has the form to go close and newcomer Alphonsus Liguori. [Conor Fennelly] Page 2 spotlightgowran park 22.04.26

7f For 3yo Weights 9st 8lbs Penalty value 1st £€10,013 2nd £€3,213 3rd £€1,513 4th £€663 5th £€323 6th £€153 SFT-HVY Trainer Jockey SP OR TS RPR Go Just Do It 3 9-8 J P O'Brien J M Sheridan 8-11 98 80 95 Ran to a very useful level in three starts last season on varying ground from 6f-7f; beaten 1l on debut behind New Zealand at the Curragh; improved to be beaten 5.5l into third in Group 2 by the smart Constitution River; similar level when second to Trojan Warrior dropped in trip 183 days ago, went with enthusiasm and traded short in-running; handles soft and should be tough to beat on return for yard in form. In The Gloaming 3 9-8 A Oliver W J Lee 40-1 - - - 33,000euros yearling; half-brother to two winners (5f to 6f, inc Group-placed); last of 12 on debut at the Curragh on debut 206 days ago; probably capable of better and gelded since but huge ask here. Jp's Express 3 9-8 M Mulvany Wesley Joyce (3) 20-1 - 9 74 Decent efforts when midfield in a pair of maidens last year on heavy ground at Galway and on the AW; far more needed here, however. Sindagan 3 9-8p1 J Murtagh Colin Keane 5-2 86 57 86 Shaped with lots of promise in two hot maidens last season, finishing third and fourth at Naas and the Curragh; first run since being gelded on return 31 days ago, beaten 2.5l by Accredited on heavy; third has won since so form likely strong; handles soft and big danger to Go Just Do It; first-time cheekpieces. Chestnut Palace 3 9-3 N Meade Adam Caffrey 14-1 - 64 81 Stayed on well to finish fifth in Naas maiden on debut in March; bit below that up in trip at this track 13 days ago but only beaten 7l when last of seven; better effort incoming down in trip but likely not enough. Solana Beach 3 9-3 J Stack Seamie Heffernan 8-1 - - - No Nay Never filly; half-sister to winners Dandhu (7f inc AW 2yo/turf Listed; RPR 107), Gustavus Vassa (1m2f; 102), Dutch Courage (6f/7f 2yo; 98) and Maid A Million (6f/7f inc AW 2yo; 97); dam unraced half-sister to 1m Group 1 winner Rajeem; yard does well with 2yos and trainer won this last year; worth a market check. Squishy 3 9-3 P W Flynn Leigh Roche 50-1 - - 31 Beaten just the one rival in two starts this term; hard to make a case for.

Having had three starts as a two-year-old, GO JUST DO IT ran to a very useful level, including when a good third in Group 2 company at the Curragh. He proved his effectiveness on soft ground when just wilting late over 6f on his last start and sets a very high standard for his rivals here back up in trip. Sindagan is his biggest danger after he finished second to Accredited at Naas on his return, and his form from last year reads well too. [Conor Fennelly] Page 3 spotlightgowran park 22.04.26

An impressive maiden winner of course and distance last year, VARSHINI got back on track with an excellent third at the Curragh last time and looks on a nice mark stepped back up to 7f. Trainer Joseph O'Brien has landed four of the last five runnings of this race and saddles three strong chances in Greydreambeliever and the unexposed pair of Zous And Me and Alibah. Tahcawin bolted up in a nursery at Fairyhouse ran with credit in the Goffs Millions last year and can be thereabouts if stall 11 doesn't hinder her too much. [Conor Fennelly] Page 4 spotlightgowran park 22.04.26

Varshini 4 9-11p J Stack Seamie Heffernan 13-2 87 89 92 Course and distance maiden winner on this card last year; improved plenty for seasonal return when beaten 0.5l into third in Curragh handicap 19 days ago, hitting the line much better; up 2lb but still well-treated back up in trip and enjoys soft ground. Independent Expert 7 9-8b D Hogan Colin Keane 10-1 84 85 95 Eight-time winner, five over this trip; landed 7f handicap at Naas on soft two starts ago; ran well off 4lb higher when beaten 6l into sixth at the Curragh 19 days ago; should go well back in trip and has won off higher in the past. Alibah 3 9-6 J P O'Brien J M Sheridan 5-1 95 57 91 Course and distance maiden winner on debut last year; ran big race when beaten under a length in Listed company at Fairyhouse afterwards; below that form when well-held in Group 3 206 days ago but that may have come too soon; stiff opening mark but open to improvement; one of three for yard that have won four out of the last five renewals. Gloriously Glam 4 9-5p A McGuinness Adam Caffrey 25-1 81 84 94 Won twice on turf last season, including at this track over a mile on good; last of 16 at the Curragh on return 19 days ago and doesn't want testing ground so up against it. Greydreambeliever 4 9-5 J P O'Brien Ronan Whelan 7-1 81 86 93 Some useful form in Britain before being bought by current connections for 30,000gns; ran a very encouraging race on stable debut when beaten 4.25l by stablemate Sindria at this track on soft over a mile 14 days ago; nudged up 3lb; drop in trip should suit and one of three strong chances for in-form stable with great record in this race. Glory To Be 4 9-4p M Grassick W J Lee 9-2 80 89 92 Navan maiden winner over 5f on soft in October; returned this term in fine form, runner-up at the Curragh over 6f before going one better at Leopardstown over 7f (yielding) seven days ago; unexposed over this trip and definite player off 6lb higher. Rion Rubette 4 9-3 M Butler Paddy Harnett (5) 14-1 79 85 93 Bolted up by 8l at Limerick over 7f in June; handicapper hammered her with 18lb after and that has proven too burdensome since; did shape well [not beaten far behind Glory To Be in second) on return when beaten 4.25l at the Curragh 19 days ago but testing ground wouldn't be ideal back up in trip. Greek Flower 7 8-13 J Feane Gavin Ryan 8-1 75 89 94 On a 16-race losing streak but shaped well on a number of occasions, including on return 7 days ago when beaten 1.75l by Glory To Be at Leopardstown on yielding; has slipped to an attractive mark and a leading player if building on return. Zous And Me 3 8-10 J P O'Brien Declan McDonogh 13-2 85 65 87 Knew enough first time out to make a winning debut at Galway in September, beating Sanctijude by 0.5l over 7f on soft; never landed a blow in Group 3 company afterwards but very unexposed and opening mark doesn't look harsh; leading player for top course trainer. Tahcawin 3 8-9 Joseph G Murphy Wayne Lordan 8-1 84 81 91 Off the mark at fourth attempt over 6f on yielding in Fairyhouse nursery in September, making light work of opening mark of 70 in beating Zarvali by 4.25l; ran well six days later when beaten 9l into 12th by Dorset in Goffs Millions; off 207 days; trainer has good record at this course and she's the type to progress but bad draw.

It's hard to get away from the Paddy Twomey-trained CITY OF MEMPHIS here after two very promising runs last year. An impressive Cork maiden winner, she was thrown into the deep-end in the Irish 1,000 Guineas next and ran with immense credit to finish fifth despite racing plenty keenly. The drop in trip should suit and she could be tough to beat on her return. Lord Massusus can chase her home, while Cowardofthecounty should be thereabouts after running well for a long way in the Heritage Stakes. [Conor Fennelly] Page 5 spotlightgowran park 22.04.26

7f For 4yo+ that since 1st May, 2025 have not won a Listed race or been placed 1st-3rd in a Group race Weights 9st 7lbs Penalties (handicaps excluded - to count from 1st May, 2025), winner of a race 4lb Penalty value 1st £€9,424 2nd £€3,024 3rd £€1,424 4th £€624 5th £€304 6th £€144 SFT-HVY Trainer Jockey SP OR TS RPR Tina's Indian 5 9-11 M Fahey Ronan Whelan 14-1 96 85 104 Impressive Curragh maiden winner in August 2024; below that form early last season but finished well with a pair of third-placed finishes at the Curragh and Naas in competitive handicaps (soft and yielding) before winning conditions race on last start, beating Senna's Girl by a neck as 1-2 favourite; form of that questionable and he's not well treated at the weights here. Cowardofthecounty 4 9-7t J P O'Brien Declan McDonogh 6-1 99 63 106 Group 3-winning two-year-old in 2024; struggled in three runs last year in stakes and handicap company; showed more and ran well for a long way from the front in Listed Heritage Stakes 7 days ago, eventually finishing eighth behind The Lion In Winter; should come on for that and step back in trip will suit; one of two for in-form yard. Lord Massusus 6 9-7 Joseph G Murphy Gary Carroll 3-1 102 57 113 Won this in 2023; consistent stakes performer with seven wins; won Heritage Stakes last season, beating Mutasarref by a neck; best subsequent effort came when fourth in Minstrel Stakes in July; two starts this season, improved from return to be beaten 3.25l behind The Lion In Winter at Leopardstown seven days ago; down in trip; mightn't want the ground too testing but shouldn't be far away and trainer has good course record. Saracen 4 9-7t J P O'Brien J M Sheridan 7-1 103 82 111 Impressive maiden winner at the Curragh in 2024; promising third in Greenham Stakes last year but finished down the field in Jersey Stakes; disappointed when last of ten in Gladness on return 25 days ago; needs to come on plenty for that but still lightly-raced and handles soft ground. Tuscan Hills 4 9-7 R De Aguiar Donagh O'Connor 9-1 100 94 109 Listed winner for Raphael Freire over 1m at Pontefract (soft) in 2024; never landed a blow in three starts last year, including in Derby; down the field on stable debut in Lincoln 38 days ago; needs plenty more. City Of Memphis 4 9-6 P Twomey W J Lee 6-4 106 82 112 Looked an exciting prospect when bolting up in Cork maiden in May, beating Bonus Time by 2.75l in good style; thrown into Irish 1,000 Guineas after and acquitted herself very well, beaten 4.5l by Lake Victoria into fifth, despite racing keenly; off 332 days; trip will suit; very unexposed and big chance, despite a less than ideal draw. Spicy Margarita 4 9-2 R De Aguiar David Egan 16-1 93 96 109 Sole win in 15 starts came in 7f AW maiden February of last year; highly-tried since; best effort came when beaten 2l into fourth by One Look in Park Express 12 months ago; well beat into eighth in same race 19 days ago; ground unlikely to suit and up against it.

7f For an extended handicap for 3yo rated 0-60 Minimum weight 8-7 Penalties (after calculation of the handicap), each race won 7lb Penalty value 1st £€5,900 2nd £€1,900 3rd £€900 4th £€400 5th £€200 6th £€100 SFT-HVY Trainer Jockey SP OR TS RPR Moonlight Molly 3 9-12 J Coogan Reese Holohan (7) 16-1 59 45 55 Out of her depth in maidens last year; mid-field at Leopardstown ten days ago on handicap debut; needs to find extra. Monocle Rocket 3 9-11p D McLoughlin Scott McCullagh 7-2 58 49 62 Ran three times at two, twice finished last; not a bad run on middle start; made a promising start for this stable when making most of the running over C&D two weeks ago; fair chance of reversing form with the more exposed winner Survivor's Code. Dream Legend 3 9-10 E Delany Leigh Roche 7-1 57 30 61 Down the field in turf/AW maidens last year; best handicap effort in November when not beaten far in sixth at Dundalk (6f); long-priced Bellewstown winner recently on first attempt at 1m, took the lead at today's distance; not guaranteed to uphold form with Imnotleavinyou. Bullet Bourbon 3 9-9h T McCourt Sadhbh Tormey (7) 13-2 56 63 65 Much improved when second at 50-1 in a 6f handicap at Dundalk three weeks ago on seasonal debut; encouraging that her best run at two was in a C&D nursery on heavy ground. Chirac 3 9-8 J Feane Ronan Whelan 5-1 55 45 60 A glimmer of promise on the second of three AW runs; took a step in the right direction with fourth at Naas over 5f on turf/handicap debut; form has been boosted by the winner Oh Cecilia and third-placed Bay Of Supremacy. Nephin Mountain 3 9-8 M Mulvany Declan McDonogh 12-1 55 47 60 Leopardstown run last week may have come too soon after C&D fourth behind Survivor's Code; may struggle to reverse the form of that race with Monocle Rocket. Spirit Above 3 9-7 K Smith Julian Pietropaolo (7) 33-1 54 - 58 Misfired gamble in a maiden at Dundalk in February; huge price at Dundalk three weeks ago on handicap debut and ran accordingly. Glen Breeze 3 9-6p P Magee Patrick McGettigan (5) 14-1 53 50 60 Appeared to find 5f inadequate at Bellewstown in his first handicap; can probably do better at this trip; others have stronger credentials. Imnotleavinyou 3 9-6t M Mulvany Wesley Joyce (3) 6-1 53 34 61 Best run last season when third on nursery debut over 5f at Naas in September; failed to build on that on her last three outings of the campaign; much more like it when runner-up from 4lb out of the handicap at Bellewstown on seasonal debut; may reverse form with the winner Dream Legend, Windsor Lily 3 9-6 Joseph G Murphy Gary Carroll 12-1 53 28 55 Not beaten far in a 6f maiden on second Dundalk start; never showed over C&D a fortnight ago; chance is not obvious. Honey Dale 3 9-0 P Mulligan Rory Mulligan (5) 16-1 47 28 59 Needs to improve considerably on Dundalk form to make any impact here; the addition of cheekpieces failed to do the trick last time, discarded now.

fine C&D second on seasonal/stable/handicap debut earns the vote for MONOCLE ROCKET who can turn the tables on 1/2l winner Survivor's Code. In another rematch of a recent clash, Imnotleavinyou may have the measure of Dream Legend this time. Chirac and Bullet Bourbon step up in trip with a definite chance. [Alan Sweetman] Page 6 spotlightgowran park 22.04.26

7f For 4yo+ rated 0-60 Minimum weight 8-7 Penalties (after calculation of the handicap), each race won 7lb Penalty value 1st £€5,900 2nd £€1,900 3rd £€900 4th £€400 5th £€200 6th £€100 SFT-HVY Trainer Jockey SP OR TS RPR Zabriskie Point 5 10-3p A McGuinness Reese Holohan (7) 4-1 61 52 67 Both wins came as a juvenile for Charlie Hills at 5f/7f on different ground types; has plunged in the ratings and profited from a drop to this grade when third at Leopardstown last week; likely contender with Reese Holohan's useful 7lb a help in easing his burden. Secret Magician 7 10-0p M Hassett Paddy Harnett (5) 20-1 58 9 66 Only three wins from 49 outings; placed seven times but has failed to make the frame in six starts since a Listowel festival fourth last September; hard to fancy. Majestic King 5 9-13 D Hogan J M Sheridan 8-1 57 33 65 E320,000 yearling and 3,000gns Godolphin cast-off; well-related; down the field on only start last season; had plenty of horses behind in a 1m Curragh maiden on reappearance; failed to improve at Navan; handicap debut now; worth a check to see how the market rates his chance relative to stablemate Hell Let Loose. Rodeeve 5 9-10p1 M J Browne Wesley Joyce (3) 14-1 54 44 63 Career-best was in a C&D maiden two seasons ago; nothing of note last season or on return at Dundalk 12 days ago; chekpieces for the first time now. Uncle Albert 5 9-8b K Cotter Nicola Burns (5) 12-1 52 30 60 No success since Cork (7f, heavy) in March 2024; continues to drop in the ratings, and is now 20lb lower than his winning mark; two runs this term not exactly persuasive; a top apprentice booked. Gobi Star 8 9-3 J Barcoe Declan McDonogh 33-1 47 32 59 Very weak form (turf/AW) since last July; sole turf win was in a 5f maiden in 2022; not an obvious contender. Rock Etoile 8 9-0v P McKenna Patrick McGettigan (5) 20-1 44 50 66 Six-time winner; out of form at Dundalk during the winter; in rear here 13 days ago in a race in which Miss Americana and Hell Let Loose were placed. Miss Americana 4 8-13 C O'Brien Shane Foley 9-2 43 48 63 Showed some ability at a modest level last season; went close over 1m here on seasonal debut with Hell Left Loose 1/2l away in third; Leopardstown run only three days later may have come too soon for her. Half Nutz 9 8-12 J Barcoe E E Ryan (10) 25-1 42 30 66 Six-time winner but his last success was in September 2022; no sign of the drought ending; down the field in two sprint handicap this season. Kayamite 4 8-10tp C Timmons Nathan Crosse 20-1 40 48 61 Has failed to reach the first four in 11 attempts, recent AW form is unconvincing. Manhattan Dandy 9 8-10 T Coyle Jimmy Dalton (7) 12-1 40 61 66 Three-time turf winner and often placed but 0-22 on AW and placed only three times; hard to make a strong case on recent AW form; however, he is so much more effective on turf that a good showing is not out of the question. Page 7 spotlightgowran park 22.04.26

Rated in the 90s in Britain in his early days, ZABRISKIE POINT (nap) gave notice of a possible first Irish win with a third placing at Leopardstown last week on his first outing in this grade. That run gives him a slight edge over Stone Bear, who still commands respect on his winter AW form. Other likely dangers are Miss Americana and Hell Let Loose, placed over C&D two weeks ago. [Alan Sweetman] Page 8 spotlightgowran park 22.04.26

1m51/2f For 4yo+ rated 0-60 Minimum weight 8-7 Penalties (after calculation of the handicap), each race won 7lb Penalty value 1st £€5,900 2nd £€1,900 3rd £€900 4th £€400 5th £€200 6th £€100 SFT-HVY Trainer Jockey SP OR TS RPR Miss Australie 5 10-1 A McGuinness Adam Caffrey 16-1 59 67 68 Ran well in a Curragh maiden last June; handicap form has been largely disappointing; tailed off on final AW start last year; soundly beaten in sixth behind today's ribal Numidia before that.
